key_patterns: Expression is a Pydantic discriminated union (StrictModel: extra='forbid', frozen=True) in src/app/transformation/contracts.py with forward-ref string fields. Evaluator src/app/transformation/evaluator.py::_value dispatches on expression.kind and raises ProblemException via _problem(code, detail) (422). Codegen src/app/transformation/codegen.py has string-emitting _py_expr/_r_expr/_sas_expr + python_source/r_source/sas_source (each writes a 'compiler=1.4.0' banner) + a GENERATORS dict; _sas_expr already raises UnsupportedOperator for join/aggregate. service.py::compile_dataflow wraps UnsupportedOperator -> BackendCapabilityMissing and stamps CompiledProgram.compiler_version='1.4.0'. SDTM lowering src/app/sdtm/service.py::lower_plan builds the IR dicts (the derive branch has access to the SdtmSpecification -> domains[target_domain].variables[*].data_type, which is where result_types must be populated per D2). The common issue model is app.validation.contracts.ValidationIssue (see examples in src/app/documents/validation.py and src/app/raw/routes.py that build ValidationIssue with uuid5 ids). sdtm/routes.py::validate_plan currently returns issues: [] — there is NO existing expression validator, so a new one must be created in the transformation package and wired in. Frontend expression-builder.tsx is a recursive typed ExpressionBuilder with KIND_OPTIONS, defaultExpression, AssignmentList, per-kind field editors, operator enums imported from @/api/generated/model; invariant: NEVER a free-text code field.
